summary: SK hynix Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K to announce a conference call for its 2026 second-quarter earnings results. The call is scheduled for July 29, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Seoul time, with a Q&A session. Participants include investors and press, with materials available on the company’s IR website. This is a routine earnings-related announcement, not a special situation event. No deal terms, strategic reviews, or corporate actions are discussed. The filing is a standard reporting obligation under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
